title: C++: Exception Handling
description: Use try-catch blocks to handle exceptions for division by zero.

steps.title: Safe Division with Exceptions
steps.description: Write double divide(int a, int b) that throws std::runtime_error if b==0. Call with valid and zero divisors, catching the exception.
hints: try { divide(10, 0); } catch (const exception& e) { cerr << e.what(); }

verification.failureMessage: Handle both valid and zero divisor
